name: runbooks
description: Typed runbooks routed per prompt over the jev-latest model, with a session-start index, a header lint and a purpose-line gate.

interface.shortDescription: Only the runbooks a prompt needs, injected per prompt
interface.longDescription: The router asks one jev-latest call which runbook purpose lines apply to each prompt and injects the matches. The session-start index names residuals, postmortems and retired tombstones. The skill holds the format, the lifecycle and the purpose-line gate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Which runbooks apply to this task?
